we have measured the centroid of high energy electromagnetic shower with a fine grided scintillation hodo-scope.

the development and application of a fine grained hodoscope for high energy physics experiments.
the measurement of the position and energy of high energy electrons and positrons.

The main takeaway from our work is that
a simple first moment calculation of the position of an electromagnetic shower using a fine grained hodoscope is a viable alternative to the more complicated methods of shower reconstruction.
a hodoscope with a fine enough granularity can be used to determine the position of a high energy electromagnetic shower with sufficient resolution for many calorimetric applications.
